system_prompt: You are a meticulous data quality analyst. Your job is to evaluate note text chunks before they are sent to an entity extraction pipeline. You must be conservative: only keep chunks that contain meaningful natural language content that would help extract scientific entities or relationships.
user_prompt:
You will receive a text chunk and a noise threshold. Analyse the chunk and determine if at least (1 - noise_threshold) of the content is meaningful prose (sentences, phrases, or bullet points that convey information). If the chunk is dominated by gibberish, page numbers, broken tables, or fragmentary tokens, mark it as noisy.

Noise threshold: {noise_threshold}.

Text chunk:
```
{chunk_text}
```

Instructions:
- Estimate the noise_ratio as a float from 0 to 1 where 0 means no noise and 1 means entirely noise.
- Set keep to false if noise_ratio >= noise_threshold. Otherwise set keep to true.
- Provide a short reason that justifies the decision.
- Provide a cleaned_preview string (<=200 characters) showing representative useful content. If the chunk is discarded, cleaned_preview must be an empty string.

Return a JSON object with exactly these keys: keep (boolean), noise_ratio (float), reason (string), cleaned_preview (string). Do not include any additional keys.
